title: Assembly: First Steps
summary: Meet the CPU itself: registers, instructions and the System V calling convention. Write real x86-64 assembly functions that C code calls.
description: Underneath every C and Rust program is machine code. In this course you write x86-64 assembly (GNU as, Intel syntax) by hand: you will learn what registers are, how arguments arrive and results leave a function, and how to read and write memory. Your functions are tested by hidden C programs, exactly the way real assembly is used in operating systems and performance-critical libraries.
